metadata.name: fee_stake
metadata.description: Stake a pump.fun coin, earn its creator fees pro-rata (the pool is a locked shareholder of the coin's fee sharing config)

instructions.name: activate
docs: Permissionless: settle a pending deposit once its window has passed.

instructions.name: claim
docs: Permissionless: push owed SOL to `owner`.

instructions.name: close_position
docs: Permissionless: close an empty position, pay its owner what is left,
return the rent to the attestor.

instructions.name: credit_deposit
docs: Attestor only: credit `owner` for `amount` sent to the pool address in
transaction `origin`. Bounded by the vault's real balance.

instructions.name: harvest
docs: Permissionless: park received fees and cross any window boundary.

instructions.name: init_config
docs: Once per deployment: the deployer becomes admin, `attestor` is the crank's
key, `fee_receiver` the platform's wallet for the launch and exit fees.

instructions.name: init_pool
docs: Create the pool (pays the launch fee): 1-minute windows, 1-hour leaving delay, always. The two
arguments are kept for compatibility and ignored (the test build still
reads them for legacy pools; see `MIN_COOLDOWN`).

accounts.name: bonding_curve
docs: Its `creator` field must be this program's creator PDA (coin launched by the site),
the signer (a wallet-created coin) or the coin's fee sharing config: only real
pump.fun coins get a pool, and junk mints cannot be used to spam pools.

instructions.name: lock_fee_split
docs: Lock the coin's pump.fun creator-fee split to 100 % to the pool, for a coin whose pump.fun `creator` is this program's PDA. The pool PDA signs
the fee-program CPIs, so nobody (creator or platform) can change the
split afterwards. See `instructions::lock_fee_split`.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the rent the fee program needs (sent to the creator PDA first, which pays as signer).

instructions.name: request_exit
docs: Attestor only: `owner` sent ≥ 0.01 SOL to the pool address in `origin`;
everything they have goes into cooldown.

instructions.name: request_unstake
docs: Wallet path out: the signer pays the exit fee; `amount` (u64::MAX =
everything) goes into cooldown.

instructions.name: rescue_token
docs: Admin only: send back, to `to`, a token that is NOT the pool's coin and
was sent to the pool address by mistake. The stakers' coin and the
pool's SOL can never leave this way.

instructions.name: set_admin
docs: Admin only: hand the admin role over (to the multisig).

instructions.name: set_attestor
docs: Admin only: rotate the attribution key.

instructions.name: set_fees
docs: Admin only: the platform's wallet and its two fees, within the caps.

instructions.name: stake
docs: Wallet path in: the signer's coins go to the vault and are credited at once.

instructions.name: unstake
docs: Permissionless: return cooled-down tokens to `owner`.

fields.name: lamports
docs: Paid to the owner.

fields.name: fee
docs: Kept by the caller for the network fee (≤ MAX_CLAIM_FEE; 0 when the owner calls).

types.name: Config
docs: `["config"]`: who may attest deposits and exits, where the platform's fees
go, and who may change that.

fields.name: admin
docs: Multisig on mainnet. Can rotate `attestor`, set the fees and hand over `admin`.

fields.name: attestor
docs: The crank's attribution key: the only signer `credit_deposit` and
`request_exit` accept.

fields.name: fee_receiver
docs: The platform's wallet: receives the launch fee and the exit fees. It
never receives any part of a coin's trading fees.

fields.name: launch_fee
docs: Paid once, by whoever opens a coin's pool (≤ MAX_LAUNCH_FEE).

fields.name: exit_fee
docs: Paid by a staker asking to leave (≤ MAX_EXIT_FEE).

types.name: DepositCredited
docs: A deposit attributed by the attestor. `origin` is the signature of the
transfer into the vault: anyone can open it and check that `owner` is the
sender.

types.name: EpochClosed
docs: Emitted when a window boundary is crossed and its fees are attributed.

types.name: ExitRequested
docs: An exit: signed by the owner (`origin` is all zeros) or attributed by the
attestor (`origin` is the signature of the SOL transfer from `owner` to the
pool address). `fee` is what the platform received for it.

fields.name: pool_bps
docs: Share of the creator fees locked to the pool of stakers: always 10 000.

fields.name: locked
docs: pump.fun creator is this program's PDA: split locked, parameters forced to defaults.

types.name: PositionClosed
docs: An empty position closed; its lifetime payouts are recorded here for good.

fields.name: total_claimed
docs: Everything ever paid to the owner by this position, last payout included.

types.name: StakePool
docs: One pool per coin. PDA `["pool", mint]`.
Registered as a locked shareholder (80 to 100 %) in the coin's pump.fun fee
sharing config: `distribute_creator_fees_v2` (permissionless) deposits SOL
straight onto this account. Every instruction first runs `sync`, which
parks newly received lamports for the running window and, at a window
boundary, attributes the finished window's fees to the stakers that were
active for the whole window.

fields.name: accounted_lamports
docs: Lamports already known to the pool (rent + unclaimed + carry).

fields.name: vault_accounted
docs: Tokens attributed to positions and still in the vault (active + pending
+ cooling down). `credit_deposit` may never push it past the vault's
real balance: the attestor cannot invent tokens.

types.name: StakePosition
docs: One per (owner, pool). PDA `["position", pool, owner]`.
`owner` is the wallet that staked: it signed `stake`, or it sent tokens to
the pool address and the attestor attested it in `credit_deposit`. Rewards can be pushed to it by anyone
through `claim`, and tokens only ever go back to `owner`.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: Who paid this account's rent and gets it back at `close_position`: the
owner (wallet stake) or the attestor (deposit credited from a transfer).

types.name: Staked
docs: A stake signed by its owner (wallet path).

types.name: StrayTokenReturned
docs: A token that was not the pool's coin, sent to the pool address by mistake, sent back by the admin.

constants.name: MAX_CLAIM_FEE
docs: Most a caller may keep from a payout it pushes: one signature's network fee.
A crank pushing n payouts in one transaction takes 5,000 / n from each, so
the payouts pay their own delivery and the stakers still get every lamport
of the fees minus that.

constants.name: MAX_LAUNCH_FEE
docs: Caps on what the admin can set as platform fees: the launch fee paid once
when a pool opens, and the exit fee paid when a staker asks to leave.

constants.name: MIN_CREDIT_AMOUNT
docs: Smallest deposit the attestor may credit: 1,000 tokens (6 decimals). The
attestor pays the rent of new positions, so dust must not be able to create
them. The crank adds a value floor on top (off-chain).

constants.name: MIN_EXIT_LAMPORTS
docs: Smallest lamport transfer to a pool address the crank reads as "the sender
wants out": 0.01 SOL. Documented for the crank and the UI; the program
itself treats every lamport that reaches a pool as fees for the stakers
(`request_exit` moves the platform's exit fee out of it when it is still in
the running window).
